ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: (1) Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh.[1692] To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.
tr: Yusabbiḥu lillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, lahul-mulku walahul-ḥamd, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرٌ وَمِنكُم مُّؤْمِنٌ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
en: (2) It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
tr: Huwal-ladhī khalaqakum faminkum kāfiruw waminkum muʾmin, wallāhu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīr

ar: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
en: (3) He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.
tr: Khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqqi waṣawwarakum faʾaḥsana ṣuwarakum, waʾilayhil-maṣīr

ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
en: (4) He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.
tr: Yaʿlamu mā fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayaʿlamu mā tusirrūna wamā tuʿlinūn, wallāhu ʿalīmum bidhātiṣ-ṣudūr

ar: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوا۟ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
en: (5) Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.
tr: Alam yaʾtikum nabaʾul-ladhīna kafarū min qabl, fadhāqū wabāla amrihim walahum ʿadhābun alīm

ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا۟ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ وَّٱسْتَغْنَى ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ
en: (6) That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allāh dispensed [with them]; and Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
tr: Dhālika biʾannahū kānat taʾtīhim rusuluhum bil-bayyināti faqālū abasharuy yahdūnanā, fakafarū watawallaw wastaghnallāh, wallāhu ghaniyyun ḥamīd

ar: زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا۟ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
en: (7) Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allāh, is easy."
tr: Zaʿamal-ladhīna kafarū al lay yubʿathū, qul balā warabbī latubʿathunna thumma latunabbaʾunna bimā ʿamiltum, wadhālika ʿalallāhi yasīr

ar: فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلْنَا وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
en: (8) So believe in Allāh and His Messenger and the light [i.e., the Qur’ān] which We have sent down. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.
tr: Faʾāminū billāhi warasūlihī wan-nūril-ladhī anzalnā, wallāhu bimā taʿmalūna khabīr

ar: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْجَمْعِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
en: (9) The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation.[1693] And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.
enNotes: [1693]- "At-Taghābun" suggests having been outdone by others in the acquisition of something valued. That Day, the disbelievers will suffer the loss of Paradise to the believers.
tr: Yawma yajmaʿukum liyawmil-jamʿi dhālika yawmut-taghābun, wamay yuʾmim billāhi wayaʿmal ṣāliḥay yukaffir ʿanhu sayyiʾātihī wayudkhilhu jannātin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadā, dhālikal-fawzul-ʿaẓīm

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
en: (10) But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.
tr: Wal-ladhīna kafarū wakadhdhabū biʾāyātinā ulāʾika aṣḥābun-nāri khālidīna fīhā, wabiʾsal-maṣīr

ar: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
en: (11) No disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh. And whoever believes in Allāh - He will guide his heart. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.
tr: Mā aṣāba mim muṣībatin illā biʾidhnillāh, wamay yuʾmim billāhi yahdi qalbah, wallāhu bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm

ar: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
en: (12) And obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.
tr: Waʾaṭīʿullāha waʾaṭīʿur-rasūl, faʾin tawallaytum faʾinnamā ʿalā rasūlinal-balāghul-mubīn

ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (13) Allāh - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.
tr: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huw, waʿalallāhi falyatawakkalil-muʾminūn

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُمْ وَإِن تَعْفُوا۟ وَتَصْفَحُوا۟ وَتَغْفِرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
en: (14) O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū inna min azwājikum waʾawlādikum ʿaduwwal lakum faḥdharūhum, waʾin taʿfū wataṣfaḥū wataghfirū faʾinnallāha ghafūrur raḥīm

ar: إِنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
en: (15) Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allāh has with Him a great reward.
tr: Innamā amwālukum waʾawlādukum fitnah, wallāhu ʿindahū ajrun ʿaẓīm

ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
en: (16) So fear Allāh as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allāh]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
tr: Fattaqullāha mastaṭaʿtum wasmaʿū waʾaṭīʿū waʾanfiqū khayral liʾanfusikum, wamay yūqa shuḥḥa nafsihī faʾulāʾika humul-mufliḥūn

ar: إِن تُقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
en: (17) If you loan Allāh a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allāh is [most] Appreciative[1694] and Forbearing,[1695]
enNotes:
[1694]- Who gives much in return for little.
[1695]- Refer to footnote in 2:225.
tr: In tuqriḍullāha qarḍan ḥasanay yuḍāʿifhu lakum wayaghfir lakum, wallāhu shakūrun ḥalīm

en: (18) Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
